# crewseats

> Buy HAZWOPER training seats for your whole crew: 40-hour, 24-hour, refresher, supervisor, train-the-trainer and awareness courses. Crew cost calculator, one checkout per course, invoices available.

crewseats (https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, 8-Hour Refresher, 8-Hour Supervisor or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The OSHA 40-hour initial HAZWOPER for general site workers. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). The 24-hour HAZWOPER for occasional and low-exposure workers. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher for every certified worker. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). The 8-hour supervisor course for foremen and site leads. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [HAZWOPER Train-the-Trainer Certification](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification): $399.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). Qualify an in-house trainer to run field days and refreshers. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification?buy=1016
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). First responder awareness for support staff. Enroll: https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

## Guides

- [Budgeting for crew HAZWOPER training](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/guides/budgeting-for-crew-hazwoper-training): The course fee is the smallest line. A realistic budget for training a crew.
- [Onboarding a new hire who already has HAZWOPER](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/guides/onboarding-a-new-hire-with-prior-hazwoper): Their certificate came from another employer. What to check before they start.
- [Online or in-person HAZWOPER for your crew?](https://crews.hazwoperosha.us/guides/online-vs-in-person-hazwoper-for-crews): Both have a place. How to choose, and how to combine them.
